title: FCA BNPL / Deferred Payment Credit Readiness Checker
description: Deterministic multi-jurisdiction BNPL compliance gap-analysis tool. Outputs Pass/Partial/Fail per obligation with article citations, composite readiness score, and AP2 JSON compliance mandate. Covers FCA DPC (FSMA 2023), EU CCD2 (Directive 2023/2225), US CFPB Reg Z (12 CFR 1026), and NY DFS BNPL Supervisory Guidance (June 2023).

jurisdictions.description: One or more regulatory regimes to assess. At least one required.

assessments.description: Obligation assessments keyed by obligation_id. Value must be Pass, Partial, Fail, or NA. Unset obligations default to Fail (conservative scoring).

composite_score.description: Weighted compliance score 0–100 across all selected jurisdictions.

gap_table.description: All obligations sorted by severity (Fail first). Includes jurisdiction, obligation name, citation, status, and recommended action.

ap2_mandate.description: AP2-compatible JSON compliance mandate. See master rules Section 8 for full schema.

mcp_tool_definition.name: assess_bnpl_compliance_readiness
mcp_tool_definition.description: Assess BNPL / Deferred Payment Credit compliance readiness across one or more of: FCA DPC (UK, FSMA 2023), EU CCD2 (Directive 2023/2225), US CFPB Reg Z (12 CFR 1026), NY DFS BNPL Guidance (June 2023). Returns composite score 0–100, jurisdiction breakdown, obligation gap table with article citations, and an AP2 JSON compliance mandate. Use when a lender, merchant, or payment provider needs to evaluate multi-jurisdiction BNPL regulatory posture or generate a machine-readable compliance mandate.

scoring_methodology: Pass=1.0×weight, Partial=0.5×weight, Fail=0.0×weight, NA=excluded from denominator. Composite = totalWeightedScore / totalWeightedMax × 100. Critical obligations (authorisation, affordability) carry weight 1.5. Conditional obligations (narrow-scope) carry weight 0.5. Standard obligations carry weight 1.0.
notes: Client-side. Zero PII. All obligation data, scoring logic, and reference tables are embedded in the HTML file. No external API calls.
